annotations.title: EU Abnormally Low Tender Statistical Screener & Labor Dignity Check

description:
[EU abnormally low tender statistical screener & labor dignity check. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Detects abnormally low tender bids under Directive 2014/24/EU Article 69 using statistical median and standard deviation benchmarks, enforcing mandatory rejection for non-compliant labor costs or illegal state aid.
Usage: Use this tool to audit submitted bids for price dumping anomalies and ensure compliance with mandatory collective bargaining minimum wages.
Returns: JSON object with { tenderTitle: string, targetBidderName: string, statisticalMetrics: object, isSuspectedAbnormallyLow: boolean, laborCostDignityCheck: object, stateAidCompatibilityCheck: object, recommendedActionsForContractingAuthority: array }.

baseAuctionPriceEur.description: Tender base auction price / maximum budget in EUR

bids.description: Array of all submitted bidder offers

bidPriceEur.description: Total financial offer amount in EUR

declaredLaborCostEur.description: Declared internal labor costs in EUR

hasStateAidAssistance.description: Whether the bidder received state aid subsidies ex Art. 107 TFEU

minimumStatutoryLaborCostEur.description: Mandatory statutory baseline labor cost stipulated in tender documents

targetBidderName.description: Name of bidder being audited for abnormally low offer
